node.statement: By the hypothesis that (lambda,alpha,beta) is a hiddenness dual witness, and by the external lem-hiddenness-dual-witness, lambda_f>=0 on F_v with sum_f lambda_f=1, alpha_i,beta_i>=0, sum_i beta_i<kappa=tau/4, and sum_f lambda_f*(p_f-p_v)+sum_i alpha_i*(p_i-p_v)=sum_i beta_i*(p_i-p_v).
